title: Quantum Entanglement
description: Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.

puzzle.goal: Two photons are created in the joint polarisation state (|HH⟩ + |VV⟩)/√2. One passes a linear polariser at angle α, the other a polariser at angle β; a polariser at angle φ projects onto cos φ|H⟩ + sin φ|V⟩. Add the probabilities of both-pass and both-blocked (by symmetry they are equal) to write the probability that the two detectors agree.
puzzle.name: Bell-state polariser correlation (cos² rule)
puzzle.form: 2 * abs ( ( cos ( α ) * cos ( β ) + sin ( α ) * sin ( β ) ) / sqrt ( 2 ) ) ^ 2
puzzle.ask: The bracket is cos(α − β), so P = cos²(α − β). Find the probability that the detectors agree for the polariser angles below (in degrees).

vars.P: probability that both photons give the same result

puzzle.method: Project the pair state onto ⟨α|⊗⟨β|: the HH and VV parts give cos α cos β and sin α sin β, each with the 1/√2 of the state. Square the modulus and double it for the both-blocked outcome.
